verdict.rationale: Glama's own docs say developers can "search, compare, and connect to thousands of MCP servers." Its llms.txt probe reports 91,626 MCP servers and 23,749 remote connectors, and any registry server can be deployed behind the Glama Gateway, so the catalog is reachable through the platform rather than just listed. A community comment about the "sea of existing ones" independently backs up the catalog's size. missing for 10: no evidence of which specific third-party apps or APIs are covered, and no evidence on how reliable or well-maintained catalog entries are when connected through the hosted gateway.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform
